sloka: इति चिन्ता परः सूतः वाजिभिः श्रीघ्रपातिभिः ।नगरद्वारमासाद्य त्वरितः प्रविवेश ह ॥२-५७-८॥
transliteration: iti cintā paraḥ sūtaḥ vājibhiḥ śrīghrapātibhiḥ ।nagaradvāramāsādya tvaritaḥ praviveśa ha ॥2-57-8॥

translations.english: Absorbed in these thoughts, the charioteer came to the citygate, carried by the swiftfooted horses, and quickly entered the city.
